FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 107
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Linda Coleman-Madison
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 05/09/2023
Senate Bill 107as introduced would increase the mortgage record tax from $.15 to $.30 for each
$100 of indebtedness, or fraction thereof and would redistribute the proceeds of the mortgage
record tax which would increase collections by the following estimated amounts to the
following entities:
Alabama Housing Trust Fund $44,800,000
County Treasuries $30,800,000
State General Fund $9,600,000
Probate Judges $4,500,000
TOTAL $89,600,000
